column1: # Draft G03 (subchapter 6.1): table stamp fields (by/at/made_at) forbidden in POST body, overwrite event was=true, and unreadable hold row yields held_by: null
# Norms: 6.1 Н1.6 «held_by» (C06-TABLE-HELD-BY-33-01), Н3 «таблица — записать строку» шаги 1, 4 (P/06.1-15)
# Stamp fields by/at/made_at are not in the manifest fields list -> 400 unknown field
# Create and then overwrite sh1: overwrite returns 200 and emits shelf.declared with was: true
# Unreadable hold record (released: "bogus") is treated as no hold (held_by: null), not 503
